title: A research center for advanced artificial intelligence in Brazil
description: C4AI focuses its research on two areas: natural language processing for the languages of Brazil, including Portuguese and Indigenous languages, and AI governance and the evaluation of large language models (LLMs).

revision.basis: Reformulação de escopo autorizada pelo mantenedor: duas linhas atuais; dados migrados preservados como históricos.
